descripcion: ARTEMIS turns natural-language instructions into reliable Android automation. It automates end-to-end workflows, captures logs, and integrates seamlessly with AI coding assistants such as Antigravity, Codex, and Claude Code.  It also achieves 99%+ success rate on AndroidWorld Benchmark.
